title: Quaintly Molten Syrian Almond Pilaf
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring almonds, pink food coloring, and a hint of nutty flavor, made in a copper pot and prepared with a mortar and pestle.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted.
Add the rinsed basmati rice and stir to combine with the onion and almonds.
Add the water, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Use a mortar and pestle to pound the cooked rice mixture until it is slightly broken down and fluffy.
Stir in the pink food coloring until the rice is evenly colored.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
